svg.text: Three-node Raft HA: replication across all nodes with consistency check

g.text: 3 ArcadeDB containers on one Docker network, all given the same Raft server list.
All containers start in parallel; Testcontainers waits for each node's HTTP health probe.
Every node's cluster endpoint is polled once a second until one of them claims leadership.
GET /api/v1/cluster -> body contains "isLeader":true (the run fails after 60s)
Database and schema go to the node that holds leadership - node 0 is not necessarily it.
CREATE VERTEX TYPE User, Photo - EDGE TYPE HasUploaded, FriendOf, Likes - UNIQUE_HASH / FULL_TEXT / GEOSPATIAL
Each node is polled until it answers the schema query, and the wait is measured rather than slept through.
A follower applying a schema entry reopens the database and answers "Database ... is not available" meanwhile
All three nodes write concurrently: two of them are followers, so their commands forward to the leader.
Convergence here is an absolute target, not just equality: every node must reach exactly 30 and 300.
A second, larger burst from node 1 alone, this time checked only for equality across the three nodes.
until(users1 == users2 && users2 == users3 && photos1 == photos2 && photos2 == photos3) atMost 60s
All three nodes must agree on both counts before the wrappers are closed.
db1.close(); db2.close(); db3.close() - tearDown skips compareAllDatabases (non-persistent containers)
